verification_report.summary: The bounded repair passes: strictness excludes the zero-Lee Vaisman counterexample, and the invariant prescribed-volume theorem matches [OV24Vaisman Theorem 4.1](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2206.08808v2). The new obstruction to big ordinary Bott–Chern classes correctly combines the [Kähler-current/modification criterion](https://annals.math.princeton.edu/wp-content/uploads/annals-v159-n3-p05.pdf), the Kähler ddbar lemma, degree-one pushforward and scalar elliptic regularity with the positive Gauduchon pairing. Both regularization bounds match [Boucksom Theorem 2.1](https://www.numdam.org/article/ASENS_2004_4_37_1_45_0.pdf); Dini and zero-Lelong preservation apply. The corrected internal reference and both coefficients agree with [STW Theorem 1.4](https://arxiv.org/pdf/1503.04491). The previously verified parallel-Lee conclusion yields Vaisman under the new strict-LCK hypotheses on the same metric. All remaining submitted deductions and included-section interfaces pass. No bounded mass property is used. Both older audits remain unchanged. Detailed deductions and source qualifications are recorded in [the audit report](/Users/mingchen/Non-Kahler/research/rethlas/verification/results/closed_loci_lck_connections_repair_01/verification_report.md).
